event.title: US Air Travel Gradually Normalizes After Three-Day Disruption
event.canonical_title: US Air Travel Gradually Normalizes After Three-Day Disruption
event.summary: US air travel is gradually returning to normal following three days of significant disruptions caused by a no-takeoff order from aviation authorities. Over the weekend, many passengers faced chaotic conditions at airports, with reports of stranded travelers waiting for updates and rebooking options.
